title: Undated Digital Planner for Goodnotes, Portrait iPad Planner, Start Any Month, Hyperlinked Daily Weekly Monthly Planner, Notability
description:
Any Monday is an undated digital planner for Goodnotes on iPad. Start on any day of the year, write your own dates, and keep going for 52 weeks. Nothing runs out on December 31.

What's inside (453 pages in one PDF)
- Cover, Contents and a Year overview with blank month grids
- Start here page: 4 steps to get going in five minutes
- Setup check page: buttons that jump, a pen test and a fix list
- Weeks page: all 52 weeks in one place, with a line to write each week's first date
- 12 month pages, each with a 6-row grid so every month fits, Goals this month and Notes
- 12 monthly habit trackers (14 habits, 31 days)
- 52 week pages: two tall columns of day boxes, This week's top 3 and Next week
- 364 day pages: Top 3, To do, Notes, Time blocks from 6am to 9pm, Good things today
- Lists page (To buy, To try, To read or watch)
- 6 notes pages

What makes it different
- Undated, and the weeks follow you: Week 1 is the week you start, whatever the month. Week 2 follows, then Week 3, for 52 weeks.
- Portrait pages in the iPad's own 3:4 shape, so the page fills the screen in Goodnotes with no blank bands at the sides.
- Hyperlinked: month tabs down the right edge of every page; Home, Year, Notes and Weeks on the top bar; every week opens its seven days; every day has large previous and next buttons, including from Sunday to the next Monday.
- One file, no zip, no stickers or add-ons to import.
- Two typefaces only, quiet ink and indigo with soft gold, large clear text.

Please note
- Undated: you write the dates. Weeks start on Monday.
- Portrait only. English only.
- Handwrite with a stylus or use your app's text tool. It is not a fillable form.
- No stickers, budget, meal or fitness sections.

Works with
Goodnotes (made for it first), Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes and Xodo on iPad and Android tablets. You need a PDF planner app. Not made for phones, e-ink tablets, or viewing in Files, Photos or a Google Drive preview.

How to start
1. Download from Etsy in a web browser (the Etsy app cannot download digital files).
2. Open the PDF in Goodnotes: Share, then Open in Goodnotes. Or in Goodnotes tap New, then Import, and choose the file.
3. Tap Open planner, follow Start here, open Week 1 and write this Monday's date.

Quick answers
- I can't download it in the Etsy app. Etsy's app does not download digital files. Open Etsy in a web browser, go to Purchases and download from there.
- Which app do I need? Goodnotes, Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes or Xodo. Files, Photos and Google Drive previews show the pages but cannot follow links.
- The links don't do anything. Turn the pen off (read or view mode) and tap again. The Setup check page tests this in one minute.
- Can I type? Yes, with your app's text tool. The pages are not a fillable form.
- How do undated weeks work? Week 1 is whichever week you start in. Write its Monday's date on the week page and on the Weeks page, then carry on with Week 2.

What you get
Any-Monday.pdf (12.2 MB, 453 pages).
Digital download. Nothing is shipped.

Help
Start with the Setup check page in the planner. Still stuck? Send the shop an Etsy message.
